passages.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I trust in You.
I have taken refuge in You.
Do not let me be put to shame.
Let me never be disgraced.
passages.original: בְּךָֽ־ יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־ אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
passages.sermon:
God is just.
God acts with justice.
I ask God to rescue me.
I ask God to deliver me.
I ask God to listen to me.
I ask God to save me.
passages.original: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־ אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my rock and my fortress.
He is a safe place for me.
I can always go to Him.
He gives the command to save me.
He protects me.
passages.original: הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
passages.sermon:
God, You are my deliverer.
Rescue me from the hand of wicked people.
Save me from the power of those who are unjust.
Protect me from those who are ruthless.
passages.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃

passages.text: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord.
God is my hope.
God is my confidence.
God has been my confidence since I was young.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

passages.text: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
passages.sermon:
I have leaned on You, God, since I was born.
You pulled me out from my mother’s womb.
I always praise You.
passages.original: עָלֶ֤יךָ׀ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

passages.text: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
passages.sermon:
I have become a sign to many people.
Many people see me as a wonder.
You, Lord God, are my strong refuge.
You protect me with Your strength.
passages.original: כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־ עֹֽז׃

passages.text: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
passages.sermon:
I speak about You, God.
I praise You with my mouth.
I do this all day.
I tell of Your splendor without stopping.
passages.original: יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is an elderly person.
The speaker is losing strength.
The speaker asks God for help.
The speaker says, “Do not discard me in my old age.”
The speaker says, “Do not forsake me when my strength fails.”
passages.original: אַֽל־ תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire, saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
passages.sermon:
My enemies speak against me.
They say harmful things about me.
Some people watch me closely.
They wait for a chance to harm me.
These people make plans together.
They join together to conspire against me.
They say, “God has left him.”
They say, “Chase him and catch him.”
They believe no one will save me.
They think I have no one to help me.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃ לֵ֭אמֹר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֲזָב֑וֹ רִֽדְפ֥וּ וְ֝תִפְשׂ֗וּהוּ כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃

passages.text: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
passages.sermon: God, do not stay far from me.\r\nMy God, come quickly to help me.
passages.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־ תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חִישָׁה׃

passages.text: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
passages.sermon:
My enemies accuse my soul.
They hate me.
Let them be ashamed.
Let them be consumed.
Some people seek to harm me.
Let them be covered with scorn.
Let them be covered with disgrace.
passages.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

passages.text: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
passages.sermon:
I am the speaker in this psalm.
I always hope in God.
I continue to praise God.
I increase my praise for God again and again.
passages.original: וַ֭אֲנִי תָּמִ֣יד אֲיַחֵ֑ל וְ֝הוֹסַפְתִּ֗י עַל־ כָּל־ תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
passages.sermon:
My mouth will speak about Your righteousness.
My mouth will tell of Your salvation.
I will do this all day long.
I cannot count how great Your righteousness is.
I cannot measure how great Your salvation is.
passages.original: פִּ֤י׀ יְסַפֵּ֬ר צִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹ֖א יָדַ֣עְתִּי סְפֹרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a believer in God.
\r\nThe Lord GOD is strong.
\r\nI will come with the strength of the Lord GOD.
\r\nI will speak about Your righteousness.
\r\nYour righteousness belongs to You alone.
passages.original: אָב֗וֹא בִּ֭גְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אַזְכִּ֖יר צִדְקָתְךָ֣ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
passages.sermon:
God, You taught me when I was young.
You began teaching me in my youth.
You are my teacher.
I still speak about Your wonderful works.
I continue to tell others about Your marvelous deeds.
I proclaim what You have done, even now.
passages.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים לִמַּדְתַּ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָ֑י וְעַד־ הֵ֝֗נָּה אַגִּ֥יד נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
passages.sermon:
God, You are my helper.
I will grow old.
My hair will turn gray.
Do not leave me, God.
Stay with me as I age.
Let me tell the next generation about Your power.
Let me show everyone who comes after me how mighty You are.
passages.original: וְגַ֤ם עַד־ זִקְנָ֨ה׀ וְשֵׂיבָה֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַֽל־ תַּעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־ אַגִּ֣יד זְרוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־ יָ֝ב֗וֹא גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
passages.sermon:
God, You are righteous.
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens.
God, You have done great things.
No one is like You, God.
passages.original: וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַד־ מָ֫ר֥וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ גְדֹל֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים מִ֣י כָמֽוֹךָ׃

passages.text: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
passages.sermon:
God has shown me many troubles.
God has shown me many misfortunes.
God will revive me again.
God will bring me up from the depths of the earth.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִרְאִיתַנוּ צָר֥וֹת רַבּ֗וֹת וְרָ֫ע֥וֹת תָּשׁ֥וּב תְּחַיֵּינוּ וּֽמִתְּהֹמ֥וֹת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ תָּשׁ֥וּב תַּעֲלֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
passages.sermon: God, You will increase my honor.\r\nYou will comfort me again.
passages.original: תֶּ֤רֶב׀ גְּֽדֻלָּתִ֗י וְתִסֹּ֥ב תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
passages.sermon:
I will praise You, my God.
I will use the harp to praise You.
You are faithful.
I will sing to You with the lyre.
You are the Holy One of Israel.
passages.original: גַּם־ אֲנִ֤י׀ אוֹדְךָ֣ בִכְלִי־ נֶבֶל֮ אֲמִתְּךָ֪ אֱלֹ֫הָ֥י אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה לְךָ֣ בְכִנּ֑וֹר קְ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
passages.sermon:
God redeemed my soul.
I sing praise to God.
My lips shout for joy.
My soul rejoices because God saved me.
passages.original: תְּרַנֵּ֣נָּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי כִּ֣י אֲזַמְּרָה־ לָּ֑ךְ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּדִֽיתָ׃

passages.text: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
passages.sermon:
My tongue will speak about Your righteousness all day.
You are God.
You are righteous.
Some people seek to harm me.
You disgrace those people.
You confound those who want to hurt me.
passages.original: גַּם־ לְשׁוֹנִ֗י כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקָתֶ֑ךָ כִּי־ בֹ֥שׁוּ כִֽי־ חָ֝פְר֗וּ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י רָעָתִֽי׃
